description: Figure 6 is a multi-line plot illustrating the proportion of harmful responses that include a rejection tendency for two models across two benchmarks as a function of a numeric x-axis setting. The x-axis is labeled with values 128, 256, 512, and 1024 on a linear scale (no unit shown), with ticks at those four points. The y-axis is labeled “Harmful with Refusal Ratio,” shown on a linear scale from 0.0 up to about 0.55, with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals. Four lines are plotted with markers and a legend: (1) a blue solid line with circular markers labeled “LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep,” rising from about 0.20 at 128 to about 0.25 at 256, then to about 0.35 at 512, and ending near 0.36 at 1024; (2) an orange solid line with square markers labeled “Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep,” increasing from about 0.15 at 128 to about 0.23 at 256, then to about 0.42 at 512, and remaining around 0.42 at 1024; (3) a green solid line with upward-triangle markers labeled “LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench,” increasing from about 0.06 at 128 to about 0.21 at 256, then to about 0.37 at 512, and ending near 0.38 at 1024; and (4) a red solid line with diamond markers labeled “Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench,” rising from about 0.24 at 128 to about 0.26 at 256, then to about 0.42 at 512, and increasing further to about 0.51 at 1024.
